subject: Recap + Procurement milestones / next steps (Peak Analytics)
messages:
From: Anjali Rao <anjali@peakanalytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today's demo + procurement questions

Thanks for the demo today — the team found the latency numbers and the dedicated capacity option compelling. A few items for clarity so we can loop in Procurement/Finance: 

- Preferred commercial path: do you support Marketplace (AWS Marketplace) procurement as an alternative to a PO? If yes, what are the contracting implications?
- Payment: we typically use PO + Net 30 for contracts > $50k/yr. Is PO acceptable vs. card?
- Security evidence: Procurement asked for SOC2 summary and a short list of in-scope controls.
- Timeline: we are aiming to have a purchase in place before end of Q2; need to align internal legal/security reviews.

Can you send a short mutual action plan we can share with Procurement? Also please attach any one-page SOW or price quote.

Thanks,
Anjali 
Sr. Technical PM
Peak Analytics

[Attachment: PeakAnalytics-demo-recording.mp4 (video)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anjali Rao <anjali@peakanalytics.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo + procurement questions

Hi Anjali — great to meet you and the Peak team today. Appreciate the clear asks; below is a concise MAP (mutual action plan) and answers to your procurement questions. I'll also attach a one-page SOW and a SOC2 summary for Procurement.

Quick answers: 
- Marketplace: we do support AWS Marketplace for certain customers. Marketplace purchases simplify procurement but may limit custom SLA/contracting language. If you prefer Marketplace, we can provide an AMI/Offer; for enterprise terms (SLA, data residency), PO/contract route is recommended.
- PO vs Card: PO + Net 30 is acceptable. We can accept a PO against a signed Master Services Agreement (MSA) or via a Marketplace order depending on your preference.
- Security evidence: attaching SOC2-summary.pdf and our security overview. For deep security reviews we coordinate a short questionnaire and can offer a readout with one of our security engineers.

Mutual Action Plan (high level):
1) Legal review (Peak) — review MSA and SOW (target 5-10 business days).
2) Security review (Peak) — SOC2 evidence, questionnaire, optional 1:1 with security engineer (target 7-14 business days concurrent with legal).
3) Finance (Peak) — confirm PO path and net terms (target 3-5 business days after approvals).
4) PO issuance / Marketplace order — once approvals are done, place PO or Marketplace order and schedule onboarding with our CS team.

Target milestones (example timeline):
- 2026-03-15: Peak legal confirms formal review start (we'll accept redlines via DocuSign).
- 2026-03-29: Security & legal sign-off complete (aiming for 2 weeks).
- 2026-04-05: Finance issues PO or approves Marketplace purchase.
- 2026-04-12: Provisioning & onboarding kickoff.

I've attached: SOW_draft_v1.pdf (1-page scope + pricing) and SOC2-summary.pdf. Also including a pricing quote workbook if you want line-item details.

Next steps: 
- Anjali: share this MAP with Procurement and flag whether you prefer PO or Marketplace.
- Peak procurement: if you want Marketplace, share the exact buyer/account ID and we'll route to our marketplace enablement team.
- Redwood: Sean to prepare final MSA with optional Marketplace attachments if needed; Rachel to be on standby for security Q&A.

Happy to hop on a short call with Procurement to accelerate. What time works for your Procurement team this week?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0199]

[Attachments: SOW_draft_v1.pdf (pdf), SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf), Redwood-pricing-quote.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Michael Dunn <mdunn@peakanalytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Anjali Rao <anjali@peakanalytics.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@peakanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo + procurement questions

Thanks Jordan — useful plan. A few clarifications from Procurement: 

- We prefer PO + Net 30. Marketplace is acceptable only if it provides equivalent invoicing and supports our SAP procurement flow. Does Redwood provide invoice PDFs and PO-matchable invoices from Marketplace purchases?
- What is your standard MSA lead time for review? Legal will prioritize but needs an expectation for how quickly Redwood responds to redlines.
- Security: can Rachel provide a short 30-min walkthrough of the SOC2 artifacts for our security reviewer? Also would like a CSV of in-scope assets + data flows for our GRC team.

Proposed internal timeline from Peak: 
- 2026-03-12: Procurement intake complete and Procurement opens legal review.
- 2026-03-19: Legal finishes first pass and returns redlines.
- 2026-03-24: Security + Legal sign-off (concurrent), then Finance to prepare PO.

If those dates look achievable we can schedule the legal kickoff next Friday.

Cheers,
Michael
Director, Procurement
Peak Analytics

[Attachment: PeakProcurement-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Dunn <mdunn@peakanalytics.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Anjali Rao <anjali@peakanalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo + procurement questions

Hi Michael — happy to run the SOC2 walkthrough. I can provide: 
- 30-min live meeting to review SOC2 scope and controls (I can do Thu 3/12 11:00am PT or Fri 3/13 9:00am PT)
- CSV export of in-scope asset inventory and high-level data flow (will redact sensitive identifiers).
- Answers to standard questionnaire items; if you can send the questionnaire, I'll prioritize those fields first.

About redlines and response SLAs: typical MSA review cycle is 3 business days for an initial Redwood response to redlines from Legal; subsequent rounds vary but we aim to close contractual rounds within 1 week for standard enterprise terms. If significant commercial/legal changes are requested (custom SLAs, data residency clauses), that can extend the timeline.

I can join the legal kickoff and help triage security items so your GRC team doesn't have to re-run the whole audit.

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com]

Quick status update and concrete next steps to keep momentum: 

Status: 
- Peak opened legal review on 2026-03-12 per your internal schedule.
- Rachel completed SOC2 walkthrough with your security reviewer on 2026-03-13 and provided CSV asset inventory.
- Redwood has received Procurement checklist and PeakProcurement-checklist.xlsx — thanks Michael.

Outstanding items & asks: 
1) Legal redlines: Michael / Peak legal to send redlines (or confirmation of 'no change') by 2026-03-26 so we can produce a final, signable MSA. If you prefer DocuSign routing, share the account email or HubSpot deal link.
2) Finance: please confirm whether you'll place a PO (preferred) or a Marketplace order. If Marketplace, please provide buyer/account ID and confirm invoice requirements for SAP PO match by 2026-03-26.
3) Onboarding: once PO/Marketplace order is confirmed, Sean will schedule a provisioning/onboarding slot (2–3 business days).

Proposed check-in cadence: weekly 15-min sync (Mon 9:30am PT) starting 2026-03-29 until PO issued. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

If timing slips, let us know the blocker and we'll propose mitigations (e.g., interim trial access on a card, or a short-term credit to bridge legal discussions).

Thanks — we're excited to move forward.

Best,
Jordan
